name: feature-auth
description: JWT auth: token creation/verification helpers, password hashing, FastAPI dependency. Universal config, works with any app.

variables.name: app_name
variables.description: Package name that imports these helpers, e.g. 'app'

variables.name: secret_env
variables.description: Env var holding the JWT signing secret

notes: After applying: 1) set JWT_SECRET in .env, 2) wire get_current_user as a dependency on protected routes, 3) TODO markers show integration points. Password hashing uses stdlib hashlib+hmac so no extra deps.
